ownership.quote: We are happy to share that OpenAGI is coming out of stealth and releasing its first foundation computer model, Lux.
ownership.note: No parent-company or acquisition evidence found; described as a standalone lab ('OpenAGI Labs') founded by researchers from MIT, CMU, and UIUC.

stage.note: No press release, Crunchbase/Tracxn profile, YC page, or company statement about any funding round was found within the time budget. The YC company-directory search and hn.algolia.com searches for 'OpenAGI'/'agiopen' returned no matching company or launch post.

note: OpenAGI Labs (brand 'OpenAGI' / product 'Lux') builds a computer-use foundation model (Actor/Thinker/Tasker modes) with a Python/Node SDK and developer console; it sells model-token API access, not hosted VMs/browsers (BYOC — the customer supplies the machine). Founders/researchers cited as from MIT, CMU, and UIUC; came out of stealth December 2025. As of 2026-09-29 new developer-console registrations were paused (REGISTRATION_PAUSED=true). No funding, accelerator, investor, or revenue information could be confirmed from the company's own pages, YC's directory, or HN within the research window; all such fields are left null/unknown rather than guessed.
